name: [UPD] Marble DUELS 🔮
description:
Flick your marble, knock marbles out of the ring and keep every one you capture! 1v1 PvP or vs bots.

✨ NEW: every Marble Bag mints a ONE-OF-A-KIND marble. 1.8% hold a PHENOMENON: fire, storm, aurora or a black hole!

⚔️ 1v1 DUELS on your server
🤖 Bots from Rookie to Legend
🗺️ 7 fields with generated maps, incl. MINI-GOLF with cups and bumpers
🏰 THE TOWER: 8 floors and the Black Taw boss
🌀 Spin: backspin to stick, topspin to follow
🎒 Drop rates shown: Mythic 0.5%, Shiny 2%
🔁 Trade up 5 marbles for 1 of the next rarity
📖 Marble Book sets pay coins and numbered LIMITEDS
👑 VIP: 2x coins + Golden Taw

🕹️ Press, pull back, let go. Phone, tablet and PC.

📜 31 Oct: one-of-a-kind marbles, trade-ups, Marble Book, maps, Mini-Golf, spin.

Like 👍 and favourite ⭐ for new marbles every update!
